confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of southern Thai tourist-town prices for July 2026; no live booking pages or current listings were consulted. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is low season and rates vary a lot by location (Ao Nang vs Railay vs inland). Cocktail and wine are estimated relative to the beer anchor (roughly 3x beer), not from direct price observation. FX: the 0.6947 USD per AUD figure for 2026-10-16 came from a search summary that cited the RBA exchange-rates page and a third-party page (ozfinancehub) that reports the same rate. I could not open the RBA F11.1 table to confirm the value, so verify it on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against southern Thai beach and island tourism towns (Phuket outside its premium areas, Koh Samui, Ao Nang-style resort strips) and general Thai provincial tourist price levels, with prices set below Phuket and Samui for mid-range and hotel categories.
